title: Care Management Referral and Outreach Timeframes
content:
Quick reference for the member services center: in every Care Management tier the member may refer themself, and each tier sets how soon the first outreach attempt is made after the referral date, how long outreach continues, how many unsuccessful attempts close the referral as unable to reach, and how long a member who declined waits before a self-referral reopens the tier.

| Care Management tier | Member may self-refer | First outreach attempt made by (calendar days after the referral date) | Outreach continues for (calendar days after the referral date) | Unsuccessful attempts, on different days, before closing as unable to reach | Wait after a member-declined closure before a self-referral reopens the tier (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Healthy Living Support | Yes | 30 | 30 | 2 | 0 |
| Care Coordination Level 1 | Yes | 14 | 45 | 3 | 30 |
| Care Coordination Level 2 | Yes | 10 | 45 | 3 | 30 |
| Maternal Care Management | Yes | 7 | 45 | 4 | 0 |
| Complex Case Management | Yes | 7 | 60 | 4 | 30 |
| Health Home Services | Yes | 10 | 45 | 3 | 30 |
| LTSS Service Coordination | Yes | 7 | 60 | 4 | 0 |

## Points of reference

- Every timeframe in this table is counted in calendar days from the referral date, except the last column, which is counted in calendar days after the closure for the reason that the member declined.
- The unsuccessful attempts that close a referral must fall on different days.
- A 0 in the last column is a wait of zero calendar days.

## Worked dates (hypothetical referral on 3 March)

| Tier | First attempt made by | Outreach continues through |
|---|---|---|
| Maternal Care Management (7 and 45 days) | 10 March | 17 April |
| Care Coordination Level 1 (14 and 45 days) | 17 March | 17 April |
| Complex Case Management (7 and 60 days) | 10 March | 2 May |
| Healthy Living Support (30 and 30 days) | 2 April | 2 April |

The wait in the last column runs from the closure date: for a hypothetical Care Coordination Level 2 member whose episode closed on 1 June because the member declined, it is 30 calendar days after 1 June; for a Maternal Care Management member in the same position it is 0 calendar days.
